## Transcription

Nr. 10023. surveyed

Duncan Neel ap.ee of James M. Whjeeler enters 5 acres of land by virtue of certificate no. 3103 for 640 acres situate in Bedford County on the Barren fork of Duck River Beginning on the South East Corner of 40 acres in the name of Andrew Erwin turning West ablong & South for Complement 14th March 1817 D. Neel
